datasets.name: fleet_now
queryLines:
SELECT COUNT_IF(ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES) AS active_buses,
 coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES THEN onboard END),0) AS total_onboard,
 COUNT_IF(ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES AND load_factor>=0.75) AS crowded_buses,
 timestampdiff(SECOND,MAX(ts_gps),current_timestamp()) AS freshest_gps_lag_s,
 MAX(ts_gps) AS max_ts_gps_utc
FROM transit.silver.vehicle_latest WHERE data_origin='observed'

datasets.name: route_now
queryLines:
SELECT route_short_name,COUNT(*) AS active_buses,SUM(onboard) AS onboard,
 SUM(capacity) AS capacity,try_divide(SUM(onboard),SUM(capacity)) AS fleet_load_factor,
 MAX(load_factor) AS max_bus_load_factor,MAX(ts_gps) AS max_ts_gps_utc
FROM transit.silver.vehicle_latest
WHERE data_origin='observed' AND ts_gps>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES
GROUP BY route_short_name ORDER BY fleet_load_factor DESC

datasets.name: headway_hour
queryLines:
SELECT route_short_name,direction_id,date_trunc('hour',arrive_ts) AS hour_utc,
 COUNT(*) AS n_headways,COUNT(headway_ratio) AS n_valid_ratios,
 try_divide(stddev_samp(obs_headway_s),AVG(obs_headway_s)) AS headway_cv,
 AVG(CAST(is_bunched AS DOUBLE)) AS bunching_rate,
 AVG(CAST(is_gap AS DOUBLE)) AS gap_rate,SUM(CAST(is_gap AS INT)) AS gaps
FROM transit.silver.headways WHERE data_origin='observed' AND arrive_ts>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY route_short_name,direction_id,date_trunc('hour',arrive_ts) ORDER BY hour_utc DESC,route_short_name

datasets.name: stop_visits
queryLines:
SELECT v.route_short_name,v.stop_id,s.stop_name,COUNT(*) AS n_visits,
 AVG(v.dwell_s) AS avg_dwell_s,SUM(v.net_board_proxy) AS net_board_proxy
FROM transit.silver.stop_visits v LEFT JOIN
 (SELECT stop_id,MAX(stop_name) AS stop_name FROM transit.silver.gtfs_stops GROUP BY stop_id) s USING(stop_id)
WHERE v.data_origin='observed' AND v.arrive_ts>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY v.route_short_name,v.stop_id,s.stop_name ORDER BY n_visits DESC

datasets.name: forecast_metrics
queryLines:
WITH verified AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY t0,route_short_name,direction_id,horizon_min,actual_data_origin
   ORDER BY scoring_ts DESC) AS rn
 FROM transit.gold.pred_vs_actual
 WHERE actual_p90_load IS NOT NULL AND actual_data_origin IN ('observed','simulated')
), latest AS (SELECT * FROM verified WHERE rn=1)
SELECT horizon_min,route_short_name,actual_data_origin,model_name,model_version,
 COUNT(*) AS n,AVG(ABS(pred_p50-actual_p90_load)) AS mae_load_factor,
 AVG(CAST(actual_in_p10_p90 AS DOUBLE)) AS interval_coverage
FROM latest GROUP BY horizon_min,route_short_name,actual_data_origin,model_name,model_version
ORDER BY actual_data_origin,horizon_min,route_short_name

datasets.name: forecast_observed
queryLines:
WITH verified AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY t0,route_short_name,direction_id,horizon_min,actual_data_origin
   ORDER BY scoring_ts DESC) AS rn
 FROM transit.gold.pred_vs_actual
 WHERE actual_p90_load IS NOT NULL AND actual_data_origin IN ('observed','simulated')
), latest AS (SELECT * FROM verified WHERE rn=1)
SELECT date_trunc('hour',target_window_start) AS target_hour_utc,
 concat(route_short_name,' / ',horizon_min,'m / ',series) AS series,
 AVG(load_factor) AS load_factor,COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT *, 'predicted median' AS series,pred_p50 AS load_factor FROM latest WHERE actual_data_origin='observed'
 UNION ALL SELECT *, 'actual p90' AS series,actual_p90_load AS load_factor FROM latest WHERE actual_data_origin='observed')
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour',target_window_start),route_short_name,horizon_min,series ORDER BY target_hour_utc

datasets.name: forecast_simulated
queryLines:
WITH verified AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY t0,route_short_name,direction_id,horizon_min,actual_data_origin
   ORDER BY scoring_ts DESC) AS rn
 FROM transit.gold.pred_vs_actual
 WHERE actual_p90_load IS NOT NULL AND actual_data_origin IN ('observed','simulated')
), latest AS (SELECT * FROM verified WHERE rn=1)
SELECT date_trunc('hour',target_window_start) AS target_hour_utc,
 concat(route_short_name,' / ',horizon_min,'m / ',series) AS series,
 AVG(load_factor) AS load_factor,COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT *, 'predicted median' AS series,pred_p50 AS load_factor FROM latest WHERE actual_data_origin='simulated'
 UNION ALL SELECT *, 'actual p90' AS series,actual_p90_load AS load_factor FROM latest WHERE actual_data_origin='simulated')
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour',target_window_start),route_short_name,horizon_min,series ORDER BY target_hour_utc

datasets.name: expectation_rates
queryLines:
WITH logs AS (
 SELECT timestamp,origin,details FROM transit.silver.event_log_206b4370_b5cc_48eb_8eba_932dcea5dc95 WHERE event_type='flow_progress'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT timestamp,origin,details FROM transit.silver.event_log_3db97dca_16f4_4d27_88eb_3563ac1749ee WHERE event_type='flow_progress'
), completed AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY origin.pipeline_id,origin.flow_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
 FROM logs WHERE get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.status')='COMPLETED'
)
SELECT origin.pipeline_name AS pipeline,origin.flow_name AS flow,timestamp AS updated_utc,
 e.name AS expectation,e.passed_records,e.failed_records,
 try_divide(e.passed_records,e.passed_records+e.failed_records) AS pass_rate
FROM completed LATERAL VIEW explode(from_json(get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations'),
 'array<struct<name:string,dataset:string,passed_records:bigint,failed_records:bigint>>')) x AS e
WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY pipeline,flow,expectation

datasets.name: pipeline_drops
queryLines:
WITH logs AS (
 SELECT timestamp,origin,details FROM transit.silver.event_log_206b4370_b5cc_48eb_8eba_932dcea5dc95 WHERE event_type='flow_progress'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT timestamp,origin,details FROM transit.silver.event_log_3db97dca_16f4_4d27_88eb_3563ac1749ee WHERE event_type='flow_progress'
), completed AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY origin.pipeline_id,origin.flow_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
 FROM logs WHERE get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.status')='COMPLETED'
)
SELECT origin.pipeline_name AS pipeline,origin.flow_name AS flow,timestamp AS updated_utc,
 CAST(get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows') AS BIGINT) AS output_rows,
 CAST(get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.data_quality.dropped_records') AS BIGINT) AS dropped_rows,
 CAST(get_json_object(details,'$.flow_progress.data_quality.warned_records') AS BIGINT) AS warned_rows
FROM completed WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY pipeline,flow

datasets.name: origin_split

UNION ALL
SELECT 'silver.headways' AS table_name,coalesce(data_origin,'unmatched') AS data_origin,COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM transit.silver.headways GROUP BY data_origin
UNION ALL

UNION ALL

datasets.name: upcoming_events
queryLines:
SELECT title,location_title,venue_key,start_ts AS start_utc,
 from_utc_timestamp(start_ts,'America/Chicago') AS start_chicago,significance,est_attendance,is_football_home
FROM transit.silver.events WHERE NOT is_canceled AND start_ts>=current_timestamp()
 AND start_ts<current_timestamp()+INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND significance>0 ORDER BY significance DESC,start_ts

datasets.name: exposure_by_route
queryLines:
SELECT route_short_name,direction_id,MIN(window_start) AS first_window_utc,MAX(window_start) AS last_window_utc,
 MAX(event_exposure) AS peak_available_exposure,
 MAX(CASE WHEN window_start>=current_timestamp() THEN event_exposure END) AS peak_future_exposure,MAX(football_home_game_day) AS football_home_game_day,
 MAX(event_timing_is_assumed) AS any_assumed_timing,COUNT(*) AS n_windows
FROM transit.gold.event_exposure
GROUP BY route_short_name,direction_id ORDER BY peak_available_exposure DESC

datasets.name: ntd_trend
queryLines: SELECT month,SUM(upt) AS boardings FROM transit.silver.ntd_monthly
WHERE ntd_id='60278' AND mode='MB' AND tos='DO' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

frame.title: Active buses · DERIVED · GPS
frame.description: Distinct latest vehicles with GPS fixes within five minutes.

frame.title: Total onboard · MEASURED · APC
frame.description: Reported people on fresh active buses; APC accuracy unverified.

frame.title: Freshest GPS lag (seconds) · DERIVED · GPS
frame.description: Current UTC minus max(ts_gps), including stale rows. NULL means no readings.

frame.title: Load by route now · MEASURED · APC
frame.description: Weighted onboard/capacity across fresh buses, fraction; max bus load preserves crowding extremes.

frame.title: Headway CV, bunching and gaps by route/hour · DERIVED · GPS
frame.description: UTC hours; CV=sample stddev/mean seconds; bunching=ratio<0.5, gap=ratio>1.5; NULL ratios excluded from rates. Observed only, last 7 days.

frame.title: Stop visits and dwell · DERIVED · GPS
frame.description: Observed inferred visits, last 7 days. Net boarding proxy is net onboard change, never gross boardings.

frame.title: MAE and interval coverage · PREDICTED vs MEASURED · APC / SIMULATED
frame.description: Separate actual_data_origin rows. Latest score per target example; n=matched forecasts. MAE is fraction (0.01=1 percentage point). p10–p90 nominal coverage 80%. Rolling scored matches, not necessarily independent holdout.

frame.title: Forecast vs observed · PREDICTED / MEASURED · APC
frame.description: Hourly averages by route and horizon, UTC. Only matched observed targets; lines show median forecast and actual window p90, fractions.

frame.title: Forecast vs simulated · PREDICTED / SIMULATED
frame.description: Hourly averages by route and horizon, UTC. Only matched simulated targets; lines show median forecast and actual window p90, fractions.

frame.title: Champion model versions · PREDICTED
frame.description: UC @champion aliases resolved at asset build time shown below; regenerate to refresh after promotion. Evaluation rows show actual scored model_version.

frame.title: Latest flow expectation pass rates · DERIVED · pipeline event log
frame.description: Latest completed flow per pipeline; pass/(pass+fail), not 1-dropped/output. Multiple expectations can test the same row; do not sum failures as unique dropped rows.

frame.title: Output, dropped and warned rows · DERIVED · pipeline event log
frame.description: Latest completed flow record, not cumulative run totals. Pipeline graph / UC lineage: core 206b4370-b5cc-48eb-8eba-932dcea5dc95 → ops 3db97dca-16f4-4d27-88eb-3563ac1749ee → gold → MLflow /Shared/aggiepulse → predictions.

frame.title: Calendar raw vs kept · DERIVED · LiveWhale filter
frame.description: Reason-level counts; sum raw/kept/dropped for full evaluated set. Noise and non-campus/virtual events are rejected.

frame.title: Rows by table and layer · DERIVED · UC table census
frame.description: Live COUNT(*) over all public Bronze/Silver/Gold tables at asset build discovery. Counts across grains are not unique passenger totals; internal materializations excluded.

frame.title: Observed vs simulated rows · MEASURED · APC / DERIVED · GPS / SIMULATED
frame.description: Separate origins per table. pred_vs_actual uses actual_data_origin (unmatched=NULL), not training origin. training_set appears only in this census, excluded from Genie.

frame.title: Upcoming significant events · DERIVED · LiveWhale / SIMULATED prior
frame.description: Next 14 days; calendar times UTC and Chicago shown. Significance and attendance are heuristics, not measured demand or event turnout.

frame.title: Event exposure by route · DERIVED · GPS / SIMULATED prior
frame.description: Available table coverage shown explicitly; peak_future_exposure is NULL without future windows. Calendar proximity priors near stops (600 m), not causal effects.

frame.title: TAMU monthly boardings · MEASURED · FTA NTD
frame.description: Agency 60278, motor bus, directly operated. UPT counts unlinked boardings, not unique students or APC occupancy; historical calibration context.
